catalog.ask.body1: {ask_name} wuxuu u shaqeeyaa sidii saaxiib khibrad leh oo akhrin kara diiwaannadaada. Isku day su'aal sida:
catalog.ask.body_with_data: Jawaabuhu waxay sawiraan diiwaanka aad ku xidhatay oo tus waxay ku salaysan yihiin.
catalog.ask.body_without_data: Ilaa aad isku xidho diiwaanka goobta, jawaabuhu waxay ku tiirsan yihiin aqoonta guud ee beeraha, oo AGRO-AI waxay kuu sheegaysaa marka ay u baahan tahay in xogtaadu noqoto mid gaar ah.
catalog.ask.example1: Waa kuwee beeraha aan mudnaanta siinno waraabka usbuucan?
catalog.ask.example2: Maxaa iska beddelay isticmaalka biyaha marka loo eego bishii hore?
catalog.ask.example3: Maxaa caddayn ah oo aan weli ugu baahanahay warbixintayada u hoggaansanaanta xigta?
catalog.ask.headline: Weydii su'aalaha aad la macaamilayso maalin kasta
catalog.ask.preview: Ka bilow su'aal aad weydiin lahayd khabiirka beeraha ama maareeyaha waraabka.
catalog.ask.subject: Su'aalaha ku saabsan hawlgalkaaga, ayaa lagaga jawaabay {ask_name}
catalog.common.button_fallback: Haddii badhanku shaqayn waayo, ku koobiye xidhiidhkan biraawsarkaaga:
catalog.common.reason: Waxaad helaysaa iimaylkan sababtoo ah waxaad abuurtay AGRO-AI akoon {organization}.
catalog.common.unsubscribe_note: Koontada, amniga, iyo iimaylada biilasha lama saameeyaan.
catalog.connect_data.body1: AGRO-AI kuma weydiiyo inaad beddesho kontaroolayaasha, dareemayaasha, ama xaashida xaashida. Waxay ka akhriyi iyaga. Soo rar diiwaanka waraabka, dhoofinta kontaroolaha, ama diiwaanka goobta, ama ku xidh nidaamka la taageeray.
catalog.connect_data.body2: Marka xogtaada la soo geliyo, talooyinka, hubinta diyaargarowga, iyo warbixinada waxay ku saleysan yihiin hawlgalkaaga halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen hagitaan guud.
catalog.connect_data.headline: Ku shaqee macluumaadka aad hore u haysatid
catalog.connect_data.preview: Isticmaal nidaamyada iyo faylasha aad hore u haysatid. Ma jiro wax u baahan in la beddelo.
catalog.connect_data.subject: Keen diiwaanka goobtaada AGRO-AI
catalog.connectors.available: Xidhiidhada la heli karo waxaa ka mid ah: {connectors}.
catalog.connectors.body1: Hawlgallada intooda badani waxay horey u wadaan dhowr habab: kantaroolayaasha waraabka, xogta cimilada, diiwaanada goobta, iyo dukumentiyada la wadaago. AGRO-AI ku xidha iyaga si ay xogtu hal meel ugu taal.
catalog.connectors.body_free: Qorshaha {plan_free} waxaad si toos ah u soo dejisan kartaa faylasha. Xiriirinta tooska ah waxaa lagu soo daray qorshaha {plan_professional}
catalog.connectors.body_paid: Qorshahaaga waxa ku jira isku xidhka tooska ah. Mid kasta oo aad ku darto waxay soo jeedinaysaa talooyin iyo warbixinno dhammaystiran.
catalog.connectors.headline: Loo dhisay si uu ula shaqeeyo nidaamyadaaga jira
catalog.connectors.preview: AGRO-AI dul fadhiya kontaroolayaashaada iyo diiwaanadaada jira.
catalog.connectors.subject: Ku xidh AGRO-AI nidaamyada aad hore u isticmaashay
catalog.field.body1: Marka qof goobta jooga uu arko soo bixitaan aan sinnayn, daadin, ama walbahaar oo ku jira block, {field_name} u ogolow inay ku duubaan goobta: qoraal cod, sawiro, sharaxaad gaaban, iyo goobta.
catalog.field.body2: Indho-indheynta waa la keydiyaa xitaa iyada oo aan la isku xirin oo la isku dhejin marka aaladda dib ugu soo noqoto onlaynka, markaa kooxdaadu waxay haysaa rikoor taariikhi ah oo ku xiran garoonka halkii fariin lumay markii ay kooxdu wada sheekaysanayeen.
catalog.field.headline: Gegida socodka u rogo diiwaanka la isticmaali karo
catalog.field.preview: Ku duub indho-indheynta cod, sawir, ama qoraal, xitaa iyada oo aan calaamad lahayn.
catalog.field.subject: Qabso waxa aad ku aragto garoonka dhexdiisa
catalog.market.body1: {market_name} wuxuu hayaa boosaska dalaggaaga, mugga qandaraaska ah, iyo soo-bandhigidda furan hal aragti, markaa suuq-geynta iyo go'aamada qorsheyntu waxay ku salaysan yihiin lambarrada hadda jira halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen xusuusta.
catalog.market.body2: Qor boosaskaga iyo qandaraasyadaada si aad u aragto inta ka mid ah dalag kastaa daboolay, halka lagugu soo bandhigay, oo hayso joornaalka go'aanka kooxdaadu dib ugu noqon karto.
catalog.market.headline: Laga soo bilaabo macluumaadka dalagga ilaa go'aamada ganacsiga
catalog.market.preview: Jagooyinka dalagga, mugga qandaraaska, iyo soo-gaadhista wada-jirka ah.
catalog.market.subject: Ku arag boosaska dalaggaaga hal meel
catalog.plans.body1: Qorshaha {plan_free} waxaa loola jeedaa isku dayga AGRO-AI hal goob shaqo. Markaad ku tiirsanaato hawl maalmeedka, qorshaha {plan_professional} wuxuu ku darayaa:
catalog.plans.body2: {plan_team} iyo {plan_network} qorshooyinka waxay ku daraan martiqaadyada kooxda, goobaha shaqada ee la wadaago, iyo ka warbixinta goobo badan oo hawlo waaweyn ah.
catalog.plans.headline: Maxaa isbedelaya markaad ka gudubto {plan_free}
catalog.plans.item_connectors: Isku xirka tooska ah ee nidaamyada la taageeray
catalog.plans.preview: Maxaa iska beddelaya qorshaha {plan_professional}, ee tirooyinka cad.
catalog.plans.subject: Marka hawlgalkaagu wax badan uga baahan yahay AGRO-AI
catalog.plans.usage_note: Bishan {organization} waxay isticmaashay {used} ee {limit} cadaymaha la soo geliyo.
catalog.reactivation.body1: Waxaad u dejisay AGRO-AI ee {organization} laakiin dib uma soo noqon dhawaan Tallaabada xigta ee ugu faa'iidada badan waa:
catalog.reactivation.headline: Hal tilaabo oo aad wax badan kaga heli karto AGRO-AI
catalog.reactivation.next_ask: Weydii su'aashaada ugu horeysa ee ku saabsan beerahaaga, biyaha, ama warbixintaada.
catalog.reactivation.next_connect_data: Ku xidh ama soo rar diiwaanka goobtaada si jawaabaha ay ugu saleeyaan hawlgalkaaga.
catalog.reactivation.preview: Hal tilaabo ayaa ka dhigi doonta AGRO-AI faa'iido badan u leh {organization}.
catalog.reactivation.subject: Soo qaado meesha aad kaga tagtay AGRO-AI
catalog.team.body1: Qorshahaaga waxaa ku jira {seats} kuraasta. Ku martiqaad dadka sameeya ama fuliya go'aannada goobta, sida waraabka, beeraleyda, iyo maamulayaasha beeraha, mid walbana sii doorka uu u baahan yahay.
catalog.team.headline: Ka shaqee diiwaanka kooxdaada oo kale
catalog.team.preview: Shaqaalaha goobta, beeraleyda, iyo maareeyayaasha waxay ka shaqayn karaan diiwaan isku mid ah.
catalog.team.subject: Keen kooxdaada AGRO-AI
catalog.unsubscribe.body: Waxaan joojinay AGRO-AI iimaylada dusha ka saaran ciwaankan. Koontada, amniga, iyo iimaylada biilasha wali waa la soo diri doonaa.
catalog.unsubscribe.invalid: Xidhiidhkani waa mid aan sax ahayn ama wuu dhacay
catalog.unsubscribe.title: Ma heli doontid iimaylo la fuulo
catalog.welcome.body1: Koontadaada {organization} waa diyaar. AGRO-AI ayaa ugu faa'iido badan marka ay fahamto hawlgalkaaga: beerahaaga iyo baloogyadaada, dalagyada aad maamusho, iyo diiwaanada aad hore u haysatid.
catalog.welcome.body2: Ka bilow inaad dib u eegto goobtaada shaqada oo aad ku darto waxa aad ka taqaano hawlgalka. Waxay qaadanaysaa dhowr daqiiqo waxayna ka dhigaysaa jawaab kasta mid gaar u ah beerahaaga.
catalog.welcome.headline: Ku soo dhawoow AGRO-AI
catalog.welcome.preview: Deji hawlgalkaaga si AGRO-AI uu ula shaqeeyo beerahaaga, biyaha, iyo diiwaannadaada.
catalog.welcome.subject: Ku soo dhawoow AGRO-AI
